verses.1: To David, a song of grace and justice: The LORD has spoken to you.
verses.2: Be humble in your ways, so that you may come before me. Walk in my presence, in the midst of my house.
verses.3: I will not do anything that goes against my own eyes. I will not make any decisions that I dislike.
verses.4: My heart is upset; it’s better for it to be away from me. I don’t know.
verses.5: I tried to open the box, but no one could get inside it. Its eyes were wide open, and its heart was full of kindness. But I couldn’t open it at all.
verses.6: My eyes see the truth of the earth; I stand before you. I walk along a path of righteousness. He will guide me.
verses.7: He shall not sit near my house. He will speak lies, and his words are false. He shall not be allowed to stand before my eyes.
verses.8: Let all the wicked of the earth be destroyed from the city of Jehovah. Let all those who do evil be removed from there.
